title: Forbidding anticomplete planar minors: Induced Erdős--Pósa property and Maximum Independent Set in QP
summary: The Erdős--Pósa theorem asserts that every graph $G$ with no $k$ disjoint cycles contains a set $X$ of $f(k)$ vertices such that $G\setminus X$ has no cycle. Robertson and Seymour showed that this Erdős--Pósa property also holds for $H$-minor models of any planar graph $H$. Equivalently, if $G$ has no $k$ minor models of $H$ pairwise at distance at least 1 (i.e. disjoint), then one can remove $f(k,H)$ balls of radius 0 (i.e. vertices) to make the graph $H$-minor free.
